card.name: Digits and dashes inside written dates
card.fires_on: The hyphen or a digit within a calendar date in news or web text, such as 14-June-2013 or May 08, 2010. It sits between the month and year or inside the day or year number.

modes.label: Hyphen in dates
modes.description: The hyphen between a month name and the year in a day-month-year date.

modes.label: Digits in dates
modes.description: A day or year digit inside a month-day-year date, often in a dated news list.

card.plain: It fires on the hyphens and digits inside dates written in web news listings.
